title: Finite affine integral closure in an open finite etale cover
statement: Let $X$ be a normal integral Noetherian scheme, where normal means every local ring is integrally closed [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-sbc-normal-dominant-galois]. Let $U\subseteq X$ be any open and let $P\to U$ be finite etale [def-weil-etale-morphism]. For every affine open $V\subseteq X$, put $A=\Gamma(V,\mathcal O_X)$, $f:P\to X$, and $B=\Gamma(f^{-1}V,\mathcal O_P)$ with the structural $A$-algebra structure. Then the integral closure of $A$ in $B$ [def-weil-pbc-integral-closure] is a finite $A$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module]. Empty opens and empty covers are included.

source.place: Tag 032L (lemma-Noetherian-normal-domain-finite-separable-extension), applied after injection into the finite etale generic algebra

proof.text: If V is empty then B is the zero ring, and its integral closure is finite. For nonempty V, integrality makes A a domain and local Noetherianity makes A Noetherian. For every maximal ideal of A the affine stalk/localization equivalence identifies its localization with an integrally closed stalk of X. Mathlib IsIntegrallyClosed.of_localization_maximal therefore makes A integrally closed.

Apply the generic-algebra embedding to obtain a finite formally etale K=Frac(A)-algebra D with an injective A-algebra map e:B -> D. Only a proposition is being proved; no definition chooses arbitrary data from this existence theorem.

D is reduced by formal unramifiedness over a field and Artinian by finite-dimensionality. Mathlib IsArtinianRing.equivPi identifies D with the finite product of fields L_m=D/m. The quotient fields are finite separable over K by the finite-etale-field instances. Each integralClosure A L_m is finite over A by the Noetherian normal separable integral closure theorem.

Map an element of integralClosure A B to its images in every integralClosure A L_m. Integrality is preserved by the component algebra maps. This gives an A-linear map F into the finite product of these finite modules. If F(x)=F(y), the product-field equivalence and injectivity of e give x=y. Mathlib Module.Finite.of_injective over the Noetherian A now proves finiteness of the source.

theorem finiteEtale_open_integralClosure_finite {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X]
    [IsIntegral X] (hX : ∀ x : X, IsIntegrallyClosed (X.presheaf.stalk x))
    (U : X.Opens) (P : U.toScheme.FiniteEtale) (V : X.Opens)
    (hV : IsAffineOpen V) :
    letI : Algebra Γ(X, V) Γ(P.obj.left, (P.obj.hom ≫ U.ι) ⁻¹ᵁ V) :=
      ((P.obj.hom ≫ U.ι).app V).hom.toAlgebra
    Module.Finite Γ(X, V)
      (integralClosure Γ(X, V) Γ(P.obj.left, (P.obj.hom ≫ U.ι) ⁻¹ᵁ V))
